items.title: What Does Content Strategy Look Like In The Age of AI Search
items.summary: A lot has changed in search over the past 4 years, much of it due to the post AI era we find ourselves in. But a lot has also stayed the same - find out how content strategy looks, which SEO foundations are still working and how we got our client top of the organic listings as well as dominating AI search through our proprietary AIR SEO mode. See a live case study for our client, Blue Light Card.
